2607.01395.title: Rethinking Generic Object Tracking Toward Human-Level Perceptual Intelligence
2607.01395.paper_summary: At the heart of human visual perception lies the ability to maintain a continuous and coherent understanding of the external world. By integrating observations with accumulated experience, the human visual system can continuously adapt to variations in both the target and its surrounding environment, while preserving robust visual continuity as scene dynamics evolve. Human vision can therefore integrate prior knowledge, spatial geometry, and semantic context to understand complex scenes and their changes. As a core problem in computer vision, visual object tracking aims to bring machine perception closer to human visual perception. These capabilities are central to the task of Generic Object Tracking (GOT). In this task, a visual tracker is initialized only with the bounding box of an arbitrarily specified target in the first frame, and must continuously localize the target in subsequent dynamic visual streams. However, future events, observations, and real-world variations are inherently unpredictable; therefore, the model's generalization and online adaptation capabilities remain bottlenecks. Tracking reliability can deteriorate when the target undergoes severe deformation, is affected by complex distractors, encounters significant environmental changes, or belongs to a category unseen during training. This dissertation aims to narrow the gap between machine visual tracking systems and human visual perception by proposing a series of methods that systematically enhance the target discrimination, robust adaptation, and geometric reasoning capabilities of tracking models.
2607.01395.paper_summary_zh: 人類視覺感知的核心在於維持對外部世界的連續且一致的理解。<lb/>通過將觀察與累積的經驗整合，人類視覺系統能夠不斷適應目標及其周圍環境的變化，同時在場景動態演變時保持穩健的視覺連續性。<lb/>因此，人類視覺能夠整合先前的知識、空間幾何和語義上下文，以理解複雜的場景及其變化。<lb/>作為計算機視覺中的核心問題，視覺物體追蹤旨在使機器感知更接近人類視覺感知。<lb/>這些能力對於通用物體追蹤（GOT）任務至關重要。<lb/>在這項任務中，視覺追蹤器僅用第一幀中任意指定目標的邊界框進行初始化，並必須在隨後的動態視覺流中持續定位目標。<lb/>然而，未來事件、觀察和現實世界的變化本質上是不可預測的；因此，模型的泛化和在線適應能力仍然是瓶頸。<lb/>當目標經歷嚴重變形、受到複雜干擾物的影響、遇到顯著的環境變化，或屬於訓練期間未見過的類別時，追蹤的可靠性可能會下降。<lb/>本論文旨在通過提出一系列系統性增強追蹤模型的目標辨識、穩健適應和幾何推理能力的方法，縮小機器視覺追蹤系統與人類視覺感知之間的差距。
